name: Gérald Darmanin
bio: Gérald Darmanin is a French politician, born on 11 October 1982 in Valenciennes. A former member of Les Républicains who joined the Macron camp in 2017, he has served as Garde des Sceaux (Minister of Justice) since December 2024, and was kept in that role in the government of Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu following the February 2026 reshuffle. He previously served as Minister of the Interior (2020–2024) and Minister of Public Action and Accounts (2017–2020), and was Mayor of Tourcoing (2014–2017).
